guides.edit:
# Editing Papier

Papier is the default theme of new decks. Keep what makes it Papier:

- The paper palette: bg and surface warm and light, ink a dark brown, ink-muted still readable on both bg and surface; on-accent must read on accent, and accent on bg.
- `accent-soft` is an extra color only Papier defines; keep it a light tint of accent. component.base.card.highlight-kicker uses it on highlight-bg (ink): keep that pair readable.
- Serif display, sans body: `font.display` is Newsreader with Libertinus Serif as fallback, and `script-style.display` is serif so other scripts fall back to a serif too; `font.body` is Instrument Sans. Weights stay light (display and title 500, strong 600).
- `chart.palette` starts with `accent`; keep six distinct colors that read on bg.
- `app` and `app-dark` color the app around the deck: keep them in the same warm tones, and app-dark's ink readable on its desk, sheet and piece.
- Component overrides: component.essentiel.chapter (surface, ink, accent number at full opacity), title-slide (bg, accent bar), end-slide (surface); component.base.card (highlight-kicker). Set only what differs from the pack defaults.
- Papier sets no size, space, page, radius or stroke tokens: it relies on the library defaults. Add them only as a set, and check the cover, the chapter slide and a content slide with cards and a table.
guides.use:
# Using Papier

Papier is the theme of a new deck: warm off-white paper (`bg` #fffdf9, `surface` #f7f5f0), dark brown `ink`, a muted green `accent` (#3f6b5e) and a pale green `accent-soft`. Titles are in Newsreader, a serif, at weight 500; body text in Instrument Sans. It suits calm, editorial, text-led decks.

- Colors by name: bg, surface, ink, ink-muted, accent, on-accent, accent-soft, rule. Keep accent for one emphasis per slide; use accent-soft only as a fill behind ink text (a shape, a highlight), never as a text color.
- Chapter slides sit on `surface` with ink text and an accent number; the cover is plain on `bg` with an accent bar; the end slide is on `surface`.
- Highlighted cards turn dark ink with an accent-soft kicker: one per slide at most.
- Charts take accent, then rust, blue, ochre, plum and ink-muted: up to six series, the key one first.
- Sizes, spacing and margins are the library defaults (titles 60, body 32 on a 1920 by 1080 page): keep bullets short, about six lines a slide.
- Header and footer are the defaults: chapter and organization on top, author, date and page number below.
- A change for this deck only belongs in the deck tokens; a lasting variant is a theme that extends Papier.
